title: smime-tree CLAUDE.md incorrectly says ParsedPart leaks into public API
description: smime-tree/CLAUDE.md dependency table says mime-tree 'Leaks into public API? Yes (ParsedPart)'. In practice, ParsedPart does not appear in any smime-tree public signature — verify() takes &[u8], not &ParsedPart. mime-tree IS a dep, but it does not leak into the public API surface. An agent following these instructions to review public API compatibility would incorrectly expect ParsedPart to be present in the smime-tree exported types.
